name: Grelden
description: A man blessed by an Icatian priest who wakes covered in enemy blood on the field of victory.

description_citations.work: Duel Decks: Divine vs. Demonic: card flavor text

timeline.summary: Grelden is blessed by an Icatian priest and wakes bloodied on the field of victory.
timeline.quote: Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

citation.text: Icatian Priest (Tenth Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An Icatian priest blesses Grelden, who later comes to himself covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.
timeline.quote: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow.
